failurePolicy: Stop at the first mandatory failure; preserve exact stdout, stderr and exception. No production repair or rerun.
mandatoryInventory: tar paths types headers terminator and bytes
SPDX 2.3 full schema and semantic recomputation
public API/closed CLI bounded package smoke
runtime closure and zero production dependencies/hooks
final evidence seal and exact report
reusePolicy: Only schema fixture results and upstream provenance can be reused after complete exact dependency checks; archive, assemblies, install, metadata, toolchain identities, document checks, closure and tamper controls receive fresh observations. Advisory history is newly reviewed with an explicit stale-currentness limitation, not same-date PASS.
network: No acquisition, provider accounts, hosted execution, npm network fallback or remote schema retrieval.
